description: KNaNbOF₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/nmm space group. K is bonded to twelve F atoms to form KF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaOF₅ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent NbOF₅ octahedra. There are eight shorter (2.90 Å) and four longer (3.04 Å) K-F bond lengths. Na is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form NaOF₅ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NbOF₅ octahedra and faces with four equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-19°. The Na-O bond length is 2.30 Å. There are four shorter (2.36 Å) and one longer (2.40 Å) Na-F bond length. Nb is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form distorted NbOF₅ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaOF₅ octahedra and faces with four equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-19°. The Nb-O bond length is 1.76 Å. There are four shorter (1.99 Å) and one longer (2.18 Å) Nb-F bond length. O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Nb atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Nb atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Nb atom.
